# 7. High-conversion real estate UX

Concept demo only (555 phones, `@acreline-concept.test`). Forms still have to behave like a real showing / lead flow.

## A. Form and input design

**7.1 Visible labels.** Never rely on `placeholder` alone. Placeholders vanish while typing and are a poor accessible name.

- Every input / select / textarea needs a visible `<label for="id">` (existing `.field label` pattern).
- Placeholder is an example (`Alex Buyer`, `(555) 010-0199`), not the label.
- Booking form (`partials/booking-form.blade.php`) is the reference. Homepage value / alert fields and WP search must not regress to placeholder-only.

**7.2 Input types and autocomplete.** Use context-aware attributes for mobile fill:

| Field | Attributes |
| --- | --- |
| Phone | `type="tel"` `autocomplete="tel"` |
| Email | `type="email"` `autocomplete="email"` |
| Name | `type="text"` `autocomplete="name"` |
| ZIP | `type="text"` `inputmode="numeric"` `autocomplete="postal-code"` `pattern="[0-9]*"` (concept ZIPs are fiction, still use the type) |
| Date | `type="date"` |
| Showing notes | `textarea` — no fake `type="text"` |

When you touch contact / guide / homepage tools, add missing `autocomplete` (booking already has it).

## B. Feedback and micro-interactions

**7.3 Loading and active states.** Interactive actions (Request showing, Submit alert, Send message, calculator submit) MUST change visually:

| State | Keystone (not indigo) |
| --- | --- |
| Default | `.btn` / `.btn-primary` — forest `#1f6b4a` |
| Hover | `.btn-primary:hover` → `--accent-dark` `#155539`. Never `hover:bg-indigo-700` |
| Active / pressed | Slight press: `transform: scale(0.98)` or keep the existing lift without fighting reduced-motion |
| Loading | Spinner (or “Sending…”) + `disabled` + `aria-disabled="true"` + do not double-submit |

`.btn:disabled` already drops opacity and kills hover lift. JS submit handlers should set that while the request is in flight.

**7.4 Live regions.** In-page results (booking confirm, alert saved, home-value estimate, listing result count, chat replies) MUST be announced.

Pattern already used:

```html
<div class="confirm-msg" id="showingConfirm" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
```

Also: `#valueResult`, `#alertConfirm`, `#resultCount`, `#chatBody`. When you add a new AJAX confirmation, give it `role="status"` `aria-live="polite"` (or `aria-live="assertive"` only for errors that must interrupt). Do not swap the node’s contents without a live region.

## Do not

- Placeholder-only fields
- `hover:bg-indigo-700` / SaaS spinner kits
- Silent DOM updates after “Book a showing”
